description: SEC 10-K critical accounting estimates — Reads the Critical Accounting Estimates (or Policies) section of a company's latest 10-K MD&A and returns each estimate: title, topic (revenue, goodwill_intangibles, income_taxes, inventory, credit_losses, contingencies, pension, stock_compensation, warranty, fair_value...), first-sentence summary, quantified sensitivity sentences (e.g. a 10% change would move cost of sales by $79 million), dollar amounts and a judgment score, plus disclosureQuality DETAILED/STANDARD/MINIMAL/CROSS_REFERENCED and the most judgmental estimate. Params: ticker= (or cik=); optional filing=1 for the prior 10-K. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_critical_estimates
